tasks.subject: [spaces-email] [P1] Add the email-link tables, keyed address hash and token clean-up
tasks.description: Migration apps/community/migrations/0032_email_links.sql exactly as spec §3: email_link_requests and email_link_tokens (both ON DELETE CASCADE to "user"), notice_outbox.community_id nullable for the three account.* kinds with the shape check, kind constraint extended; backout note in the header. NOTICE_KINDS and NoticeRequest.communityId (string|null) in mail/outbox.ts. security.ts gains hmacSecret(value, secret) (HMAC-SHA256, 'email-link:' prefix, hex) with TSDoc on why addresses are keyed and tokens are not. clearAccountAccess deletes email_link_tokens for the user behind the same to_regclass guard as pending_sign_in_links. Prune in main.ts: request rows after 24 h, token rows 1 h after expiry/consume/supersede. Config: COMMUNITY_EMAIL_LINK_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE (default 5, max 100) and COMMUNITY_EMAIL_LINKS_PER_HOUR (default 300, max 10000). Changes to #2555 code: AccountAccessKeep gains sessionId?: string; clearAccountAccess returns { removed, xid } (pg_current_xact_id()::text); request-start.ts markAccessCleared(userId, xid) and writtenBeforeClearing exempts only while access_cleared_xid equals that xid; link-gate.ts passes its xid. Prune nulls email and drops any request pending over 1 h, whether or not mail is on. Add linkCookieName(config) to sign-in/link-gate.ts (__Host-community_pending_link on HTTPS, community_pending_link on HTTP; Path=/, no Domain, Secure on HTTPS) and move every #2555 read and write of the pending-link cookie onto it; add the signInHoldOnly SQL predicate (TRUE until DOR-2711's 0033).

tasks.phaseName: P1 — Spaces email links (one PR, after #2555)
tasks.subject: [spaces-email] [P1] Record requests the same way for every address, and resolve them in the mail worker
tasks.description: src/email-links/requests.ts: POST /api/v1/account/password-reset {email} per spec §6 — mail off 409 NOTICE_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE; per-IP minute and hour limits (IPv6 keyed by /64) from a new email-links/limiter.ts with its own bounded store (not app.ts's shared attemptTimes); normalize; one plain INSERT of a pending row, no counts; always 202 {accepted:true}; never reads "user". POST /api/v1/sign-in-link/email (live pending cookie required, per-account 3/h honest 429, sets the pending row's expires_at = LEAST(created_at + 25 min, now() + 15 min) and re-issues community_pending_link with maxAge equal to the new remaining lifetime). POST /api/v1/account/email-confirmation (browser session, 409 when confirmed, per-account 3/h 429). user.create.after and bootstrap/complete queue an email_confirmation request when mail is on and the email is unconfirmed. src/email-links/resolver.ts run by the mail worker each tick when mail is on: claim ≤20 pending rows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, decide per the §5 eligibility table; an eligible request over the per-address (3 queued/h, 10 queued/24h) or host-wide queued cap becomes throttled; otherwise queue the account-level outbox row in the same transaction, set state/outbox_id/resolved_at, null the email; Wire schemas in @dorkos/shared/community-wire. The request route reads and re-issues the pending-link cookie only through linkCookieName and selects the pending row with signInHoldOnly.
acceptanceCriteria: Known, unknown, erased and throttled addresses get byte-identical responses (T4)
A recording pool shows identical SQL for known and unknown addresses and no read of "user" (T5)
No per-address limit in the request path; the resolver throttles over queued rows only (T6)
Per-IP minute and hour 429s, one /64 counts as one IP, host cap throttles (T7)
Filling app.ts's attemptTimes leaves the email-link limiter intact, and the reverse (T23)
The pending row cannot outlive created_at + 25 min and the re-issued cookie matches its lifetime
After resolve the plaintext email column is null (T15); resolver drops no account, refused account (T14), already confirmed, vanished pending link
Mail off: all three routes 409 and nothing is queued

tasks.phaseName: P1 — Spaces email links (one PR, after #2555)
tasks.subject: [spaces-email] [P1] Mint tokens in the composers and mail the three messages
tasks.description: src/email-links/composers.ts registering account.password_reset, account.sign_in_link, account.email_confirmation in main.ts's noticeComposers. Each composer: read its request; older than 1 h (reset, sign-in) or 24 h (confirmation) → null; re-check eligibility; in one transaction supersede live tokens of that kind for the account and insert the new token (hashSecret, email_hash, password_fingerprint for reset, pending_link_hash for sign-in, expiry 30/15/1440 min, outbox_id); return plainTextMail with the spec §8 copy and a link built only from config.publicUrl (/reset-password#, /email-sign-in#, /confirm-email#). auth-options gains emailLinks (mail on and all three composers registered); sign-in-methods gains emailConfirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: The fake SMTP body holds the only copy of the raw token; the table holds 64-hex hashes (T15)
Links stay on publicUrl under a forged Host or X-Forwarded-Host (T16)
A newer mail supersedes the older link (T9)
SMTP down → request still 202, outbox retrying; past the window → NOTICE_OBSOLETE and no token minted (T19)
Subjects are one line; copy matches spec §8

tasks.phaseName: P1 — Spaces email links (one PR, after #2555)
tasks.subject: [spaces-email] [P1] Use reset and sign-in links through a Better Auth plugin
tasks.description: src/email-links/plugin.ts communityEmailLinks: POST /email-link/reset-password {token,newPassword} and POST /email-link/sign-in {token}, per spec §6 'Use'. One transaction: lock "user" then members (community_id,id) then the token FOR UPDATE; §5 checks (kind, live, unexpired, address hash, password fingerprint for reset, signInRefusal); stale facts mark the token superseded and answer 410 LINK_EXPIRED. Reset: write the credential row with Better Auth's hasher, clearAccountAccess({password:true, links: confirmed}) then markAccessCleared(userId, xid), confirm when never confirmed, consume, audit member.password_reset (+cleared) and member.email_confirmed ['reset']. Sign-in: refuse with 410 LINK_EXPIRED ('Open it in the browser where you asked.') unless this browser's community_pending_link hashes to token.pending_link_hash and that row is live and for this account (token untouched); lock and consume it; never confirmed → markAccessCleared + clearAccountAccess({password:false,links:false}) + confirm + audit; insert the held account row (unique violation skips the link) and recordSignInLinked([provider,'email'(,'cleared')]); consume. After commit: internalAdapter.createSession + setSessionCookie; refused → 403 SIGN_IN_REFUSED. Hono middleware spends email-link-use:<peer> on /api/auth/email-link/*. Mail off → 409. Response cleared is 'access' (confirmed: sessions, connections, agent credentials, pairings, invites, host API keys) or 'everything' (also old sign-in links). No linkSkipped. The sign-in use reads the cookie through linkCookieName and the pending row with signInHoldOnly.

tasks.subject: [spaces-email] [P1] Peek and confirm routes
tasks.description: POST /api/v1/email-links/peek {token} → {kind,email,expiresAt,clears,needsPassword,signedInAs}; consumes nothing; 410 when not usable; per-IP limited in the email-link limiter. clears lists what using the link ends (sessions, connections, agent_credentials, pairings, invites, host_api_keys, plus password and sign_in_links on a never-confirmed reset or sign-in). POST /api/v1/account/email-confirmation/confirm {token,newPassword?}: browser session required (401, token untouched); lock user, members, then token; §5 checks; other account → 403 (token untouched); already confirmed → consume, cleared 'none'. Never confirmed: credential row exists and no newPassword → 400 PASSWORD_REQUIRED (token untouched); write the new password; clearAccountAccess({password:true, links:true, sessionId: this session}) and markAccessCleared(userId, xid); set emailVerified; consume; supersede other confirmation tokens; audit member.email_confirmed ['link'] and member.password_reset ['password','confirm']; cleared 'others'. clears is z.array(z.string()) (open list); signedInAs is { email, method: null } | null.
acceptanceCriteria: The victim's browser with no session cannot confirm a squatted account; a later trusted OIDC sign-in still clears it (T2)
Squatter hands the victim the password; the victim confirms with a new password → squatter's session dead, old password fails, grant and agent credential revoked, victim's session lives (T2b)
Confirm without newPassword on an account with a password → 400, token live
Peek never consumes and lists clears correctly per case; cross-origin POST refused (T18)
GET of the three pages leaves tokens live (T8)
